messages:
maria-release: Starting tenant metadata swap in the 02:00 UTC quiet window. Plan: stagger by tenant-range groups to limit lock contention. Pin runtime to v3.4.2 for the swap. Groups: 0-9, 10-29, 30-99. Abort criteria: any AccessExclusive lock >5s OR replica lag >30s. tagging @jason-oncall @kevin :eyes:
kevin: Ack. I'll monitor p99 latency + replica lag. Which perf board should I watch?
sree: Quick Q — who runs the revert script if we need it? Need explicit owner in runbook.
maria-release: Good call. Runbook updated with owner (SRE oncall) and steps. Short escape sequence: unflag pk_swap, pin workers back to 3.4.1, run revert backfill. Manual SQL snippet in runbook:
```sql
-- revert tenant metadata for a tenant range
BEGIN;
UPDATE tenants SET metadata_version = 'v1' WHERE tenant_range BETWEEN 30 AND 39;
COMMIT;
```
jason-oncall: I'll be standing by. Ops channel open. tagging @ops-bot
deploybot: deploybot: kickoff group 0 (ranges 0-9). est ~6m. logs streaming to #release-stream
anna-prod: Group 0 done — quick checks: no long locks, p99 unchanged, replica lag steady. :thumbsup:
kevin: Starting group 1 (10-29). I'm watching dashboard: https://perf.redwood.internal/dashboards/migration
kevin: Observed brief p99 spike +120ms for ~30s after start of group1; locks stayed <200ms. Still within thresholds.
maria-release: Holdpoint before group 2. Kevin — capture a pg_locks sample and tail app logs for the hold. If lag >30s we abort.
jason-oncall: pg_locks sample excerpt: `pid=2345 rel=tenant_meta mode=AccessExclusive granted=false wait=0.2s` — transient. App log tail shows backfill throughput: `[2026-03-23T02:05:14Z] backfill: group=10-19 processed=120 batch_ms=95`
deploybot: deploybot: attempted to start group 2 but paused per manual hold. retry queued in 5m.
kevin: Suggest we reduce batch_size from 200 -> 50 and add 100ms sleep between batches to reduce lock pressure.
maria-release: Agreed. Applying adjusted config: `BATCH_SIZE=50 SLEEP_MS=100`. If any group shows locks >5s we'll revert that group immediately.
kevin: Pushing config update to deploybot now.
deploybot: deploybot: updated config `migration_batch_size`->"50", `migration_sleep_ms`->"100". scheduled group2 retry in 2m.
anna-prod: group2 retry started. Early telemetry: p50/p95 fine, p99 ~80ms, no locks >1s.
sree: Note to update release notes with the adjusted batch settings and rollback commands so SRE can follow without extra context.
maria-release: Done — release notes updated and runbook artifact attached. Rollback command: `scripts/tenant_meta_revert.sh --group <n>`; open incident tag `migration-rollback` when running. Keep updates coming.
kevin: Monitoring. Will call abort if thresholds breached.
jason-oncall: I'll stay on for 30m post-completion.
maria-release: Thanks. Will continue staggered rollout and post final status when group 30-99 completes or earlier if aborted.
